name: @workspace/dsh-jp-translate
description: 日语翻译 agent preset for DSH: a tool-free translation mode whose every model request carries ONLY the system prompt and the user's source text — no history. The system prompt is the fixed translation contract; the [Glossaries] term pairs come from preset-based settings edited in the Web settings page through two text boxes (原始文本 / 翻译文本), saved as selectable presets.
